chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a drainage pit that is situated above the well. He said: “If it is lower than the well, then five cubits; and if it is above the well, then seven cubits from every side, and that is ample.”

key_terms.أَسْفَلَ: lower in position relative to something else
key_terms.الْبَالُوعَةِ: a drainage pit or sewer opening
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: a well from which water is drawn
key_terms.وَذَلِكَ كَثِيرٌ: that amount is ample or more than sufficient

ai.seo_question: What distance should be kept between a drainage pit and a well according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the required distance between a drainage pit and a well. It distinguishes between whether the drainage pit is lower or higher relative to the well, establishing precautionary measurements to protect water purity.
